question:
Fill in the blank with the most suitable collocation.

It is impossible that the bank will ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**forgive a debt**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**forgive a debt**" is a common collocation, meaning to cancel or waive the repayment of a debt.
 
• The bank forgiving a debt implies that the borrower is no longer obligated to repay the amount.
 
• Other options like "**follow a debt**," "**fragment a debt**," and "**format a debt**" do not make sense in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is impossible that the bank will forgive a debt__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Follow a debt:** This is not a standard collocation in English.
 
• **Fragment a debt:** This phrase is incorrect and not used in financial contexts.
 
• **Format a debt:** This is not a valid expression in the context of banking or finances.
